inject_and_call_available.meaning: the router contract exposes an injectAndCall function

balance_read_is_router.meaning: _getSelfBalance(token) reads the router contract's own balance rather than the user wallet's balance

assumptions: injectAndCall is invoked directly on the router contract rather than via delegatecall from a user wallet
the router contract is the msg.sender/execution context for the direct call

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the router holds a nonzero ETH/ERC20 balance at the time of a direct call, so the balance-read subject cannot be tied to a concrete nonzero amount.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the self_balance_reads_router impact; drain and arbitrary-target-funds impacts are handled in separate passes.
The balance-read subject is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric balance values.
